d: Yemen—a land once known as ‘Arabia Felix’ (Happy Arabia), the birthplace of Mocha coffee, home to the ‘Manhattan of the Desert,’ and the place where the Dragon Blood Tree is found. It is a land where the ancient ruins of Marib stand as a testament to human ingenuity. There is so much more to know about Yemen—things you truly ought to discover. So, join us on a journey to Yemen, right here on Infinity Stream.
